description: This Java source file defines an abstract validator class for MQTT protocol configurations within a larger connectivity/messaging framework. It includes validation logic for source and target configurations, including QoS settings, topic patterns, enforcement policies, and address placeholders. The class ensures MQTT-specific constraints and applies placeholder substitutions, serving as a base for concrete MQTT validator implementations.

classes.name: AbstractMqttValidator
classes.description: An abstract validator class for MQTT protocol configuration, performing validation on source and target settings, QoS levels, topics, enforcement policies, and address placeholders within an MQTT connectivity context.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration, ensuring QoS is specified and enforcement policies are valid.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, ensuring QoS is specified and address placeholders are valid.

methods.name: getHiveQoS
methods.description: Converts an integer QoS level to the corresponding MQTT QoS enum.

methods.name: validateSourceEnforcement
methods.description: Validates enforcement configuration for the source, applying placeholder filters and MQTT topic validation.

methods.name: validateEnforcementInput
methods.description: Validates the enforcement input expression, ensuring it can be processed with existing placeholders.

methods.name: validateSourceQoS
methods.description: Validates that the source QoS level is within acceptable MQTT QoS values.

methods.name: validateTargetQoS
methods.description: Validates that the target QoS level is within acceptable MQTT QoS values.

methods.name: validateQoS
methods.description: Helper method to check QoS value validity based on a predicate.

methods.name: validateAddresses
methods.description: Validates MQTT address strings for sources and targets, ensuring topic format correctness.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Validates a single MQTT address, throwing an exception on invalid format.

methods.name: validateMqttTopic
methods.description: Checks if an MQTT topic string is valid, supporting wildcards based on context.

methods.name: invalidValueForConfig
methods.description: Creates a detailed exception indicating invalid configuration values.

methods.name: applyEntityPlaceholderToAddresses
methods.description: Substitutes placeholders in addresses and returns a map of original to substituted addresses.

methods.name: applyEntityPlaceholder
methods.description: Performs placeholder substitution on an address string using entity-specific placeholders, reporting unresolved placeholders.
